app.name: Agora
app.tagline: The board your group decides in.

share.heading: Share the agora
share.explain: Whoever opens this link joins the agora and can vote.
share.qrAlt: QR code for the agora link

common.offline: Offline. What you do now is sent when you are back.

board.empty: Nothing here yet. The first proposal is yours to make.
board.archivedExplain: Done, rejected and closed. Still here, just out of the way.

quorum.noDeadline: No deadline: it stays open until everyone votes.

actions.closeReasonHint: At least 10 characters. The group gets to read it.

setup.heading: Agora is not configured
setup.explain: The server connection is missing, so no agora can be opened. Running locally, copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in the two variables.

proposal.title: Title
proposal.descriptionHint: Markdown works: headings, lists, links and images.
proposal.deadlineHint: Optional, but without it the proposal stays open until everyone votes.
proposal.titleTooShort: A title needs at least 3 characters.
proposal.costInvalid: The cost is in euros, two decimals at most.

identity.whoExplain: Pick your name to join {{agora}}. If you are not there, add yourself.
identity.notOnTheList: I am not on the list
identity.nameTaken: That name is already in the agora. Pick it from the list.
identity.notMe: Not you? Pick who you are again.

create.heading: Create an agora
create.agoraNameHint: Whatever you call it between you: the flat, the crew, the family.

danger.heading: Delete the agora
danger.explain: Everything goes: proposals, votes, threads and images. There is no undo.
danger.confirmLabel: Type the agora name to confirm
danger.mismatch: The name does not match, so nothing was deleted.

images.tooLarge: That image will not go under 200 KB even compressed. Try another.
images.limit: Ten images per proposal, which is plenty.
